name: Evolvable structure that optimizes intent (ESOI)
vision_statement: Every intention is turned into a structure that optimizes the fulfilling of that intent while supporting changes to it, and the intent and the structure evolve together in a continual feedback loop.
solution_coherence: Apply ESOI to a project (apply-esoi) is the whole: a person or an AI turns a project's intent into specifications that are checked, measured and selected by metric, and everything else serves one of its two implementations, the tools or the documents alone. The records are the center: Intent registry (intent-registry) holds them, Template sync (template-sync) derives their fields from the author's skill, Ownership map (ownership-map) ties every file to a component and a solution, and Readable records (readable-records) and Review tracker (review-tracker) show them to a reader. Specify from the code (specify-from-code), Specification index (spec-index), Spec search (spec-search) and Local ESOI index (local-application-index) keep the records in step with the code and find the few a task concerns. Rule engine (structure-check) applies the Structure rules (structure-rules) on each change, bounded by Structure budget (structure-budget), and Consumer check (consumer-check) does the same for a system built on the library. Results come from the Measurement harness (measurement-harness), whose cases are proven by Discriminating cases (discriminating-cases), kept as a record by keep-metric-record, set against Grade evidence (public-evidence) that others measured, scheduled by When metrics are run (when-metrics-are-run), and judged by the Leaderboard (leaderboard); Implementation selection (implementation-selection) then uses the verdict and Promote the winner (promote-the-winner) switches the selected implementation. For people and AI, The ESOI steps (the-steps) give the order, delivered as Follow the steps (follow-the-steps), with The standard (the-standard) and Documentation and templates (docs-and-templates) as the no-code form, Skill distribution (skill-distribution) publishing the author's skill safely, and ESOI applied to AI behaviour (esoi-for-ai) measured by Behave by ESOI (behave-by-esoi) and graded when patterns cannot tell by the ESOI behaviour judge (esoi-behaviour-judge), measured as Judge ESOI behaviour (judge-esoi-behaviour). Together they let intent and structure evolve in one loop: specify, measure, select, and improve what the metrics say is worst.
